# LinkFortySDK (iOS)

> Native Swift SDK for LinkForty — an open-source mobile attribution and deep link management platform. Handles Universal Links, deferred deep linking (install attribution), in-app event tracking with offline queue, revenue tracking, and link creation. Zero external dependencies. Works with LinkForty Cloud (linkforty.com) or self-hosted Core instances.

## Requirements

- iOS 16.0+
- Swift 5.9+
- Xcode 15.0+

## Installation

### Swift Package Manager (Recommended)

In Xcode: File → Add Package Dependencies → Enter URL:

```
https://github.com/linkforty/mobile-sdk-ios
```

Select version: Up to Next Major (1.0.0).

### CocoaPods

```ruby
# Podfile
pod 'LinkFortySDK', '~> 1.0'
```

Then run `pod install`.

### Carthage

```
github "LinkForty/mobile-sdk-ios" ~> 1.0
```

## Swift Types

```swift
struct LinkFortyConfig {
    let baseURL: URL
    let apiKey: String?                  // nil = no link creation
    let appToken: String?                // Cloud only — recommended; enables organic-install attribution
    let debug: Bool                      // default: false
    let attributionWindowHours: Int      // default: 168 (7 days), range: 1-2160
}

struct DeepLinkData {
    let shortCode: String
    let iosURL: String?
    let androidURL: String?
    let webURL: String?
    let utmParameters: UTMParameters?
    /// Custom key-value parameters set when the link was created
    let customParameters: [String: String]?
    /// In-app destination path (e.g., "/product/123")
    let deepLinkPath: String?
    /// Custom URI scheme (e.g., "myapp")
    let appScheme: String?
    let clickedAt: Date?
    let linkId: String?
}

struct UTMParameters {
    let source: String?
    let medium: String?
    let campaign: String?
    let term: String?
    let content: String?
}

struct InstallResponse {
    let installId: String
    let attributed: Bool
    /// Attribution confidence score (0-100)
    let confidenceScore: Int
    /// Matched fingerprint factors (e.g., ["ip", "user_agent", "timezone"])
    let matchedFactors: [String]
    let deepLinkData: DeepLinkData?
}

struct CreateLinkOptions {
    let templateId: String?              // auto-selected when nil
    let templateSlug: String?
    let deepLinkParameters: [String: String]?
    let title: String?
    let description: String?
    let customCode: String?
    let utmParameters: UTMParameters?
}

struct CreateLinkResult {
    let url: String                      // full shareable URL
    let shortCode: String
    let linkId: String
}

/// All errors thrown by the SDK
enum LinkFortyError: Error {
    case notInitialized
    case alreadyInitialized
    case invalidConfiguration(String)
    case networkError(Error)
    case invalidResponse(statusCode: Int?, message: String?)
    case decodingError(Error)
    case encodingError(Error)
    case invalidEventData(String)
    case invalidDeepLinkURL(String)
    case missingApiKey
}
```

## SDK API

The SDK uses a singleton: `LinkForty.shared`. All async methods use Swift async/await.

```swift
import LinkFortySDK
```

### initialize(config:) async throws -> InstallResponse

Initialize the SDK, report the install, and return attribution data. Must be called before any other method.

```swift
let config = LinkFortyConfig(
    baseURL: URL(string: "https://go.yourdomain.com")!,
    apiKey: "lf_live_abc123",       // optional — only for createLink()
    appToken: "at_a1b2c3d4...",     // recommended for Cloud — enables organic-install attribution
    debug: true,
    attributionWindowHours: 168
)

let response = try await LinkForty.shared.initialize(config: config)

print("Install ID:", response.installId)
print("Attributed:", response.attributed)
print("Confidence:", response.confidenceScore)
```

### onDeepLink(\_ callback:)

Register a callback for direct deep links — fires when user taps a Universal Link and the app is already installed.

```swift
LinkForty.shared.onDeepLink { url, data in
    print("Deep link opened:", url)
    if let route = data?.customParameters?["route"],
       let id = data?.customParameters?["id"] {
        NavigationManager.shared.navigate(to: route, id: id)
    }
}
```

### onDeferredDeepLink(\_ callback:)

Register a callback for deferred deep links — fires on first app launch if the install was attributed to a link click.

```swift
LinkForty.shared.onDeferredDeepLink { data in
    if let data = data {
        print("Attributed install from:", data.shortCode)
        if let route = data.customParameters?["route"],
           let id = data.customParameters?["id"] {
            NavigationManager.shared.navigate(to: route, id: id)
        }
    }
}
```

### handleDeepLink(url:)

Forward Universal Links to the SDK for processing. Call this from your AppDelegate or SwiftUI `.onOpenURL`.

```swift
LinkForty.shared.handleDeepLink(url: url)
```

### trackEvent(name:properties:) async throws

Track in-app events. Failed sends are queued offline (max 100 events) and retried automatically.

```swift
try await LinkForty.shared.trackEvent(
    name: "add_to_cart",
    properties: ["productId": "789", "price": 29.99]
)
```

### trackRevenue(amount:currency:properties:) async throws

Track revenue events. Amount must be non-negative.

```swift
try await LinkForty.shared.trackRevenue(
    amount: Decimal(29.99),
    currency: "USD",
    properties: ["productId": "789", "orderId": "order_123"]
)
```

### Last-click attribution (automatic)

Every event (including screen views) is automatically stamped with the deep link that most recently opened the app — deferred install or direct re-engagement — plus an app-open `sessionId`. The newest deep-link open supersedes the previous one, and the active link persists across app restarts. Events with no preceding deep-link open are organic (session only). No code is required; the backend uses the stamp to credit in-app activity to the originating link.

### trackScreenView(name:properties:) async throws

Report a screen view for per-link screen-flow funnels. Emits a `screen_view` event (with `screen`, the previous screen as `previousScreen`, and the attribution stamp). Throws on an empty name.

```swift
// UIKit — from viewDidAppear
Task { try? await LinkForty.shared.trackScreenView(name: "ProductDetail") }
```

SwiftUI — use the `.linkfortyScreen(_:)` view modifier:

```swift
ProductView()
    .linkfortyScreen("ProductDetail")
```

No navigation swizzling: mark the screens you care about, which keeps screen names meaningful.

### createLink(options:) async throws -> CreateLinkResult

Create a shareable link. Requires `apiKey` in config.

```swift
let result = try await LinkForty.shared.createLink(
    options: CreateLinkOptions(
        deepLinkParameters: ["route": "product", "productId": "789"],
        title: "Check out this product!",
        utmParameters: UTMParameters(source: "in_app_share", medium: "referral")
    )
)

print(result.url)       // https://go.yourdomain.com/tmpl/abc12345
print(result.shortCode) // abc12345
print(result.linkId)    // uuid
```

### Offline Event Queue

```swift
LinkForty.shared.queuedEventCount   // number of events waiting
await LinkForty.shared.flushEvents() // manually flush
LinkForty.shared.clearEventQueue()   // clear without sending
```

### Utility Methods

```swift
LinkForty.shared.getInstallId()    // String?
LinkForty.shared.getInstallData()  // DeepLinkData?
LinkForty.shared.isFirstLaunch()   // Bool
LinkForty.shared.clearData()       // clear all stored data
LinkForty.shared.reset()           // reset to uninitialized state
```

## Universal Links Setup

1. In Xcode: target → Signing & Capabilities → + Capability → Associated Domains. Add:

```
applinks:go.yourdomain.com
```

2. Configure your Apple Team ID and App Bundle ID in the LinkForty dashboard (Settings → App Configuration).

3. LinkForty automatically serves `/.well-known/apple-app-site-association` from your domain.

## Complete SwiftUI Example

```swift
// MyApp.swift
import SwiftUI
import LinkFortySDK

@main
struct MyApp: App {
    @StateObject private var deepLinkRouter = DeepLinkRouter()

    init() {
        Task {
            do {
                let config = LinkFortyConfig(
                    baseURL: URL(string: "https://go.yourdomain.com")!,
                    apiKey: "lf_live_abc123",
                    appToken: "at_a1b2c3d4...",
                    debug: true
                )
                let response = try await LinkForty.shared.initialize(config: config)

                if response.attributed {
                    print("Install attributed with confidence: \(response.confidenceScore)")
                }

                LinkForty.shared.onDeferredDeepLink { data in
                    if let data = data {
                        DispatchQueue.main.async {
                            deepLinkRouter.handleDeepLink(data)
                        }
                    }
                }

                LinkForty.shared.onDeepLink { url, data in
                    if let data = data {
                        DispatchQueue.main.async {
                            deepLinkRouter.handleDeepLink(data)
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch {
                print("LinkForty init failed:", error)
            }
        }
    }

    var body: some Scene {
        WindowGroup {
            ContentView()
                .environmentObject(deepLinkRouter)
                .linkfortyScreen("Home") // reports a screen_view (attribution-stamped) on appear
                .onOpenURL { url in
                    LinkForty.shared.handleDeepLink(url: url)
                }
        }
    }
}

// DeepLinkRouter.swift
class DeepLinkRouter: ObservableObject {
    @Published var route: String?
    @Published var routeId: String?

    func handleDeepLink(_ data: DeepLinkData) {
        self.route = data.customParameters?["route"]
        self.routeId = data.customParameters?["id"]
    }
}
```

## Complete UIKit Example

```swift
// AppDelegate.swift
import UIKit
import LinkFortySDK

@main
class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func application(_ application: UIApplication,
                     didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]?) -> Bool {

        Task {
            let config = LinkFortyConfig(
                baseURL: URL(string: "https://go.yourdomain.com")!,
                apiKey: "lf_live_abc123"
            )
            let response = try await LinkForty.shared.initialize(config: config)

            LinkForty.shared.onDeferredDeepLink { data in
                if let data = data { self.routeToContent(data) }
            }

            LinkForty.shared.onDeepLink { url, data in
                if let data = data { self.routeToContent(data) }
            }
        }

        return true
    }

    func application(_ application: UIApplication,
                     continue userActivity: NSUserActivity,
                     restorationHandler: @escaping ([UIUserActivityRestoring]?) -> Void) -> Bool {
        guard userActivity.activityType == NSUserActivityTypeBrowsingWeb,
              let url = userActivity.webpageURL else { return false }
        LinkForty.shared.handleDeepLink(url: url)
        return true
    }

    private func routeToContent(_ data: DeepLinkData) {
        guard let route = data.customParameters?["route"],
              let id = data.customParameters?["id"] else { return }
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
            // Navigate to the appropriate view controller
        }
    }
}
```

## Testing Deep Links

```bash
# iOS Simulator
xcrun simctl openurl booted "https://go.yourdomain.com/abc123"
```

## Self-Hosted vs Cloud

The only change is the `baseURL`:

```swift
// Cloud (managed SaaS)
let config = LinkFortyConfig(baseURL: URL(string: "https://go.linkforty.com")!)

// Self-hosted (@linkforty/core)
let config = LinkFortyConfig(baseURL: URL(string: "https://links.yourdomain.com")!)
```

All SDK methods work identically with both.
